step_1_identify_the_delta.rounding_band: with both leaves rounded to 0.1, the true ratio lies in [1.11946, 1.12054]

candidate_amplifiers_in_this_scenario.Abyssal Mask - Unmake / Curse: x1.12 (S1, S3) - the ONLY candidate inside the rounding band

step_1_identify_the_delta.conclusion: The two leaf values differ by exactly one application of the Abyssal Mask Unmake curse (12% increased magic damage). No other amplifier available in this scenario reproduces the observed factor. Because mitigation x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage (S5), the amp factor factors cleanly out of the post-mitigation number, so the ratio test is exact.

step_2_what_the_source_authorizes.target_scope: enemy champions within 700 units of the wearer; 'become cursed' is a boolean debuff state on the target, not a per-source counter (S1)
step_2_what_the_source_authorizes.damage_type_scope: magic damage only (S1 wording 'increased magic damage'; the atom decomposition types Unmake as damage.magic, S4)
step_2_what_the_source_authorizes.source_scope: 'from all sources' scopes WHICH incoming damage instances are amplified (any attacker, ally or self) - it is not a licence to multiply the amp once per damaging source or once per curser
step_2_what_the_source_authorizes.therefore: a cursed target's magic damage taken carries the factor 1.12 exactly once; combined with Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable the legal total is 1.07 x 1.12 = 1.1984, and 1.12^2 = 1.2544 is not authorised by any cached text

step_3_case_analysis.setup: Let B be the event's damage with every amp except the curse question resolved; then new = B*k_new and old = B*k_old with k_old = 1.12 * k_new. The set of source-legal curse factors for a single event is {1.00 (non-magic damage, or target not cursed), 1.12 (magic damage on a cursed target)}.
step_3_case_analysis.case_I: k_new = 1.00, k_old = 1.12 (B = 197.5). Both factors are individually legal; which one is right depends on whether event 24 is magic damage on a cursed target.
step_3_case_analysis.case_II: k_new = 1.12, k_old = 1.2544 (B = 176.34). Here the old value applies the unique curse twice - the signature of accumulating the same named aura once per roster source. k_old is not authorised by any cached source, so the old value is wrong outright.
step_3_case_analysis.resolution: Case II is the reading the scenario itself points at: the scenario is named '..._curse_roster', i.e. it exercises the curse across a multi-participant roster, which is exactly the configuration in which a per-source amp accumulator yields 1.12^n instead of 1.12. In Case I the new value is also the correct one (a non-magic event must not carry a magic-only amp). The old value is correct only under the single remaining branch of Case I - event 24 being magic damage on a cursed target whose legitimate, single curse the engine now drops - which would contradict the scenario's own purpose (the corpus pins curse application in this very scenario) and is supported by no cached source.
step_3_case_analysis.verdict_reasoning: Every source-supported branch lands on 197.5; the branch supporting 221.2 requires the engine to be silently dropping a legal single curse in the one scenario built to pin it, with no textual support. Verdict: new_value_correct.

step_4_numeric_reconstruction_attempted.note: The scenario's input tuple (champion, level, build, target, fight mode) lives in scripts/, which this runbook forbids reading, so an absolute reconstruction of 197.5 from raw damage is not available to this oracle. The corpus conventions in S6 (level-18 target at 52 MR / 92 armor) were used to sanity-check plausibility only.
consistency_checks: Case II base B = 221.2 / 1.2544 = 176.34; 176.34 x 1.12 = 197.5 (matches the new leaf)
Case I base B = 197.5; 197.5 x 1.12 = 221.2 (matches the old leaf)

physical reading of 197.5 vs 92 armor => raw 379.2 (197.5 x 1.92); magic reading of 197.5 vs 52 MR => raw 300.2 (197.5 x 1.52) - both are attainable, neither discriminates, so the verdict rests on the amp-legality analysis above, not on the reconstruction

confidence: high on the delta identification (the 1.12 factor is unique in the rounding band and matches the Abyssal Mask sourced value exactly); moderate-to-high on the direction, established by case analysis over source-legal amp factors rather than by an absolute reconstruction of the event.
